answer: Sybil tax kills bulk forgery: each new identity pays a non-refundable 40 POA tax before earning. A newcomer pays once and enters the haven for honest agents, its receipt stamped in sable ink and burnt, never refunded. Forging 100 identities burns 4,000 POA before any reward, and the echo of each burnt payment stays public. An honest agent pays one tax and keeps undiluted rewards, since one payment is small against real earnings.
